title: tonningia cristata
intro: Tonningia cristata, commonly known as 'Mountain Coral', is a medicinal plant species native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Tonningia cristata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
